title: Internal to section scalar and pullback comparison data
statement:
Let $a:\Lambda\to\Lambda'$ be a morphism of commutative condensed rings. On each small pro-etale site put $A_T=p_T^*\Lambda$, $B_T=p_T^*\Lambda'$ and use the internal scalar extension $e_T$, its total left-derived functor $D_T$, exact restriction $V_T^0$, geometric pullback $L_{f,R}$ and their computation maps from [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons]. Write $E_{R,T}$ for the exact section-module equivalence, $\bar E_{R,T}=D(E_{R,T})$ for its localization and $Q$ for complex localization [def-pd-section-derived-tensor-data]. Use the specified ordinary and derived section geometric functors, adjunctions and comparison isomorphisms from [def-pd-section-derived-realization]. The coefficient map $a_T^{\mathrm{sec}}$ and balanced internal generator are those of [def-sfb-section-scalar-map-data]. A section scalar comparison $s_T$ consists of an actual section scalar-derived pair $(e_T^s,D_T^s,\varepsilon_T^s)$ for $a_T^{\mathrm{sec}}$ [def-sfb-scalar-hom-comparison-data], and natural isomorphisms
$$V_T^0 E_{A,T}\simeq E_{B,T}V_T^s,\qquad e_T E_{B,T}\simeq E_{A,T}e_T^s,\qquad D_T\bar E_{B,T}\simeq\bar E_{A,T}D_T^s,$$
where juxtaposition in these three displays means apply the left functor first. Define $\operatorname{SectionScalarNormalized}(a,T,s_T)$ to require: its restriction comparison is the identity on every section; its ordinary comparison carries the internal generator $z\otimes x$ to the sheafification of the section tensor $z\otimes_{A_T(U),a_T(U)}x$ under the pair's specified ordinary-extension object identification; and, for every internal complex $P$ whose section realization is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex] with every term flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], the following two maps agree: the image under $\bar E_{B,T}$ of the internal scalar computation map followed by the section-localization comparison and the localized termwise ordinary comparison; the derived scalar comparison at $QP$ followed by $D_T^s$ of the section-localization comparison and the pair's computation map at $E_{A,T}(P)$. Define $\operatorname{scalarSectionPullComparison}(R,f)$ to be exactly the fixed geometric comparison $L_{f,R}\bar E_{R,X}\simeq\bar E_{R,Y}L^s_{f,R}$, with the internal pullback written using $L$.

For any scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$, any $s_X,s_Y$ of the above kind and any internal isomorphism $b:D_Y L_{f,B}\simeq L_{f,A}D_X$, define $\operatorname{SectionPullNormalized}(a,f,s_X,s_Y,b)$ as follows. There exist ordinary section isomorphisms $r:F^s_{f,B}V_Y^s\simeq V_X^sF^s_{f,A}$ and $c:e_Y^s L^s_{f,B}\simeq L^s_{f,A}e_X^s$ such that $r$ is the identity on every section and the conjugate of $c^{-1}$ under the actual composite ordinary scalar/geometric adjunctions is $r$. There also exists $d:D_Y^sL^s_{f,B}\simeq L^s_{f,A}D_X^s$ with the following two properties. For every flat-term K-flat section complex $P$ on $Y$, the map $d_{QP}$ followed by $D_X^s$ of the exact-pullback localization factor and the scalar pair computation map at $L^s_{f,A}P$ equals $L^s_{f,B}$ of the scalar pair computation map at $P$, followed by the exact-pullback localization factor at $e_Y^sP$ and the localized termwise $c$. Finally, for every internal derived object $M$ on $Y$, the image of $b_M$ under $\bar E_{B,X}$, followed by $s_X.\mathrm{derived}_{L_{f,A}M}$ and $D_X^s$ of the fixed pullback comparison at $M$, equals the fixed new-coefficient pullback comparison at $D_YM$, followed by $L^s_{f,B}$ of $s_Y.\mathrm{derived}_M$ and $d_{\bar E_{A,Y}M}$. All functors and computation maps here are the specified ordinary unbounded, uncompleted ones. These are data and predicates; no existence or compatibility theorem is asserted.
